job.job_description:
A Prompt Engineer at Jalopeura with 4-9 years of experience specializes in crafting, refining, and optimizing prompts for large language models and other generative AI systems to achieve desired outputs for our applications.
Responsibilities
Designs, tests, and refines prompts to elicit specific, high-quality responses from large language models (LLMs) used at Jalopeura.
Develops prompt engineering best practices, guidelines, and frameworks for various use cases within Jalopeura.
Collaborates with product teams and developers at Jalopeura to integrate LLMs effectively into applications.
Analyzes model outputs to identify prompt weaknesses, biases, and areas for improvement for Jalopeuras AI.
Explores advanced prompt techniques such as few-shot learning, chain-of-thought, and self-consistency for Jalopeuras models.
Manages and version controls prompt libraries for different applications and models used by Jalopeura.
Stays current with advancements in LLM capabilities and prompt engineering research to benefit Jalopeura.
Develops automated testing and evaluation metrics for prompt performance in Jalopeuras context.
Provides training and guidance to other teams at Jalopeura on effective prompt design.
Optimizes prompts for efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and real-time performance for Jalopeuras generative AI.


Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
